frame_time_convention: frame start time; no center correction

outputs.f0_hz: rough autocorrelation F0; 0 means unvoiced/low confidence
outputs.hnr_db_proxy: autocorrelation periodicity proxy in dB; not calibrated HNR
outputs.formants_hz_estimate: up to 3 coarse spectral peak estimates; zeros mean unavailable
outputs.breathiness_proxy: fraction of spectral power above 4kHz in [0,1]

limitations: Descriptors are diagnostic estimates, not ground truth or production-grade acoustic analysis.
Formant estimation is coarse FFT peak picking; singing formants may be missed.
HNR and voice-quality descriptors require manual/independent validation.
No forced alignment between audio and MIDI/phonemes is inferred.
